summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn; Task.finished_time field; finished now derived from finished_time; _reset clears it; capture logic in update and advance; explicit clear in reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with lazy imports and TYPE_CHECKING Table annotation); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entry); tests/test_palette.py (new test_rich_cast); tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column, import and column-list entry, and test_columns expected output regenerated by hand-tracing clock reads). Not verified by running: test_columns expected output was derived by tracing, so it needs a real test run to confirm. Bar run lengths (25 and 16) and elapsed cell positions were checked with grep.
